decision_log.reason: Local improvements do not establish sufficient transport-only value.
Strong existing alternatives already map requirements, run tests and report evidence.
Candidate must demonstrate lower decision effort beyond existing configuration/templates.

decision_log.decision: Separate archived evidence validity from current-directory drift
decision_log.reason: 8/8 archived images match; later local overwrites can coexist with correct historical snapshots.
Beginner/low-frequency labels alone do not establish repeat work, access or payment.

decision_log.decision: Prepare one offline P0 before a model-connected MVP
decision_log.reason: Need stable inputs and readable uncertainty for a credible comparison. Not permission for endless infrastructure development.

decision_log.decision: Separate integrity, applicability, review suggestion and owner approval
decision_log.reason: An existing file, matching version and business acceptance are different claims.

decision_log.decision: Hot state plus four documentary research files
decision_log.reason: Current user permits GitHub research recording on the same state branch, not product code push.
Requirement revision, target code revision, evidence generation revision and current snapshot checkout must not be conflated.
Adopt task-specific evaluation methods and portable local contracts, not the deprecated hosted Evals API.

decision_log.decision: P0 data index is not a weakened competitive baseline
decision_log.reason: Later comparison must use full reasonable native/spec/report capability with comparable data/budget, not deliberately disorganized files.

hypotheses.claim: Criterion-linked applicable evidence reduces correct-decision human effort versus the strongest existing baseline
hypotheses.falsifier: No gain including setup/preparation/reading, extra false acceptance/rejection, or excessive abstention.

hypotheses.claim: Owners with recurring responsibility for low-risk Web changes are reachable and value this workflow
hypotheses.falsifier: No repeat actual task, alternatives already satisfactory, or interest only in a hypothetical demo.

hypotheses.claim: A small module is easier to adopt than a separate application
hypotheses.falsifier: Additional setup exceeds saved effort or required execution access is unavailable.
